notes.title: NecroBouncer x Ludeo integration
notes.content:
Heyo, bouncers! 

How're you today? I've got a lil' question for you.

Have you ever looked at someone else's gameplay, and thought to yourself: "Damn, I would do this WAY better!"? Even if you didn't - I think that the thing I'm going to show you will make you say "I never knew I needed this!"

Let me introduce to you: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/6982a17dc01d68dc2ee84874880f24356ac864a8.png

In short, it is like making a short video via Instant Replay, but you actually can play that exact bit. And the good thing is - you don't need to install anything! Except for the game of course. 

Yeah, I was confused too. Let me explain this a bit better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/05d95970f6afe7a9c7f0a511e8715867dcfaae86.png

Basically, Ludeo is a social media for gamers, where every piece of content is playable. You can capture the most epic moments of your gameplay, and let other people play it! 

When you enter an in-game area, where capturing moments is possible - you will see a popup that will notify you when you can capture your gameplay. Simply press Ctrl+L to record the last minute of your game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/c7449626c3c0b9ea3485f7150a11dbcf5bdddf72.gif

To upload your gameplay - you will need to close the game through the main menu (avoid Alt+F4 though), and head over to Ludeo Creator Studio 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/45f87badf11d9ee01b4a5bf790629b896744a53a.gif

There, you can trim your clip and assign tasks for others to complete. For example - Deal X damage, Kill X enemies, Kill X enemies flawlessly, i.e. without taking any damage. You can also set a task to gain extra points (yeah, there are leaderboards)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/d584c678aed04b0e3c5cebd5f8000ebef9c0c967.gif

A bit of minor editing, and you're good to go! Publish your Ludeo and share your link. Everyone will be able to replay that exact moment and compete on who will do it with the most points. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/af60106ff978da62c1d26f6725054edc0f6e7a05.gif

I've played a bit with this thing and honestly - it is SO much fun. You can access it right here

Ludeo will launch right after i make this announcement, so you can try out this awesome thing RIGHT NOW!

And, well, if it wasn't obvious at this point - NecroBouncer now has a full support of Ludeo! We've created a channel in our Discord server for you to discuss it and share your Ludeos.

notes.title: NecroBouncer | NG+ Update
notes.content:
Greetings, club members!

We are bringing you a major update that adds a NG+ mode to the game but also adds extra relics and balance changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/61de99f7fc8b4a6637c79a0d38eeeeef557e22f0.jpg

New Game+

After defeating the game for the first time, you will now unlock the first set of negative modifiers with which you can increase the difficulty of the game. You can then choose and enable any or more modifiers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/69af8a5769c99daf19867e44361f5c5fb6e3f0fd.jpg

Each modifier will have its own difficulty score and you will need to reach a certain threshold to unlock the next set of modifiers when beating the game again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/24e8860bdfcd60683ca37ad1a47b5b17b1444f53.jpg
Some positive modifiers will also unlock every few times you lose a run, and with them you can decrease the difficulty of the game. But these will lock certain steam achievements (while they are enabled) and you will also be unable to unlock the next set of negative modifiers with them.


Other New Things
Power Gems

Power gems are no longer obtainable from leveling up, but instead, a new special room reward has been added (Relic Reward), which is shown on the map the same as the normal relic reward but with a different image. The first time on each floor, this reward will give you 1 random power gem to equip and each subsequent one will give you one of the gem-specific relics (for which you have a power gem in an active slot).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/3247b9f87c46e7e1e00488e8f1abded7d461da55.jpg
The gem equipping scene/menu has been redesigned so it is more clear and a bunch of small graphical and practical issues has been fixed. When getting to the chest, the player now first hits the chest open, from which the selected random gem pops up and only after that does the menu open.

Reward Rooms

Epic relics in normal reward rooms are now much rarer - they can only appear in the last quarter of the floor and the chance for them to appear there is 0.5% instead of 6%. (0.625% with the Whip).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/7beab8edc69357989fc37e900bc51ab20a12524f.jpg
After every boss fight, instead of getting a random relic dropped on the floor, you go to a reward room after and get to choose from a random selection of epic relics (rare relics replace epic relics if there is not enough of them).


Bar

Added 2 new items to the bar:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/28a86617764c211785a40c81f4ce4a798cabd524.png
Strong Drink - Remove a random debuff. It costs 40 gold and increases by 40 each time it is purchased (even if on different floors).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/65b423b9c0b7eb69ae1d59ff0b249b9130ca8101.png
 Big Tip - Refresh the bar (refreshes all items in the bar). It costs 25 and increases by 100% every time it is purchased (even on different floors).


New Relics

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/64cdfb2c288c62ac48bda72ae6376353f07b4c00.png
Roulette Rounds - Enemies have a 16/33% chance to spawn an explosion when getting hit by a ranged attack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/b0f500361ef22cb10e7c2bcf28f592a8a2573d95.png
Very Old Champagne - Increase the chance for cursed relics to appear by 100/200%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/6da5379bc3a41308a07d7218b0290d7d9d4da4ee.png
Christmas Tree Increase the chance for health to drop by 100/200%


Codex Menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/0ec9d51404afd676446f083b10fe7a4b0df38e7d.jpg
Added a menu on the title screen that lets you check all of the relics and debuffs and you can also see how many are yet to be unlocked.

Added Spacial Audio to the game, so now things that are closer to the player are louder and vice versa.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1786830/NecroBouncer

Thank you for taking the time and reading through this rather big change log! We hope you’ll enjoy the new content and we’d love to hear your feedback!

notes.title: NecroBouncer | Guidebook
notes.content:
Greetings, visitors and welcome to our establishment once again!

NecroBouncer was just released a week ago and today we'd like to share with you helpful information on how to stay alive in the club during your shift. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1786830/NecroBouncer/

We'll cover three floors of our bar, leaving the contents of the fourth one a bit of a secret for you to experience yourself. Each of the floors has its own set of enemies, which can be categorized as ranger, charger, heavy, and caster (from the 2nd floor onwards). 

This will keep you on your toes and adapt to each attack your enemies use. While ranger, for example, might seem like an easier type of target to dispatch, you can be hit (and may I tell you it is not a pleasant feeling) by a caster or a heavy, so you also need to prioritize your targets accordingly. 

Now to each of the Floors currently available.

1st Floor
First floor will consist of Pitchforks, Shovel Peasant and Blacksmith.

Pitchforks guys 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/abae0ad1d647148e4524910461a0c75fab36edc4.gif
[expand type=details]They are rather straightforward - they throw pitchforks at you.
Albeit with a caveat - they won’t attack again until they pick them up. You can use it to get rid of them without extra danger to yourself.[/expand]



Shovel peasants 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/b93701f6adf4176082b721beee0f9218785b716c.gif
[expand type=details]They will run towards the player and attack with a short jump that damages if NecroBouncer is caught in its path.[/expand]


Blacksmith 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/0e36de53315bba1bfe9fecb79ff13a58d1e0b3c5.gif
[expand type=details]Compared to other Floor 1 enemies will have higher HP than others and will use an AOE attack whenever he gets close to the player, though the attack has a delay so you can try and avoid it.[/expand]

It is also important to note that Heavy enemies will also have blue HP bars, which represent a “shield”, making them unable to get staggered. When hit below 33% HP, they will lose that shield.

2nd Floor
Second floor will consist of Holy Archer, Crusader, Paladin and Cleric.

Holy Archer 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/e5023eb3331e9f8ac191ca78b720bd2b6c6bdab6.gif
[expand type=details]He'll have a ranged attack and use it every couple of seconds without having to go recharge it like Pitchforks guys had to.[/expand] 


Crusader
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/79c6eec0131ad9ecb54a0d631214473e7fa74b1f.gif
[expand type=details]Behaves much like the Shovel Peasant, will run towards you and attack in a short straight line, but he will repeat that attack once before going on cooldown.[/expand] 



Paladin 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/720a56dea04873d19cf90376b2a5db18ebccc128.gif
[expand type=details]He will be the heavy type in this floor, but instead of having a close-range AOE attack, he will shoot slow-moving projectiles in a circle around him, so it is still possible to avoid the attack by carefully maneuvering around said projectiles.[/expand]


Cleric 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/1aeafe1e05c895a17489ebd8b1a61cac712aebf2.gif
[expand type=details] Has two different abilities that are going to be used randomly. The first one will be “Orbital bombardment”, which will spawn a couple of orbital strikes around the player and the second will be “Revive”, which will revive one enemy at random.[/expand]

3rd Floor
Third floor will consist of Frost Archer, Frost Warrior, Frost Paladin and Frost Mage. 

Another thing to note is that this floor introduces the slow mechanic and ice crystals, that upon death explode and slow the player if he is hit. The more the “slow bar” is filled, the slower the player moves. If the slow bar is filled up, the player is stunned for 2 seconds. So, better try and avoid getting hit by them.


Frost Archer 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/045df199c81c6fa027e79c363b2001182be935be.gif
[expand type=details] He's just like the Holy Archer, except it has a triple shot and it spawn an ice crystal on death. [/expand]


Frost Warrior
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/479460687ac039258b159de52657ccb2eb171e5b.gif
[expand type=details]Same as Shovel Peasant, but if he is near an ice crystal, he will destroy it, granting him a heavy shield, increased HP, movement speed and attack speed.[/expand] 


Frost Paladin 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/28e9ddae834e2340920349f19af7dc5ca4838bfd.gif
[expand type=details] Is the scary one here. He will roll a big snowball toward the player. If the snowball hits an ice crystal, it destroys it and grows a bit bigger.[/expand]


Frost Mage 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/41402c3e5c4c2169d8a506a25c0848f9738449b0.gif
[expand type=details] Mage will spawn ice crystals in a circle around the player, crystals deal damage when they come out of the ground.[/expand]

Now you know what you can expect from various inhabitants and regulars of our bar.

notes.title: NecroBouncer | Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Greetings, club members!

We hope you enjoy your stay in the club, while we bring more & more changes to the game to make it better. As always, all of your feedback throughout the past few days was highly appreciated. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/b9628ed48b0282228f76190996bfea982c82ff77.jpg

Changes

 Removed a bunch of unnecessary logs and errors and added some markers throughout the game which will make it easier to debug.
 The wind-up animation of the Pistol Whipper (trap door enemy 4th floor) has been extended a bit.
 Explosion damage (from things like Jalapeno, Ghost Pepper, etc.) has been reduced from 40 to 25.

notes.title: NecroBouncer | Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Greetings, club members!

A small follow-up update, with a few fixes based on issues reported by the community.

Changes

 The game will now save the progress after every beaten room, so that the game will be saved in case of an unfortunate crash.
 All levelling relics are now double checked and unlocked at the start of every run if necessary, which should prevent the game from ever getting stuck in the level up screen.
 The Protection Statue now kills enemies at the end through code instead of collider and also not everyone at once, which should decrease the risk of that room causing a crash.
 The game will now check a few additional things when trying to load a saved run, so in case of a crash, it should delete the saved run (in the case something isn’t ok) but it should still save the progress of the game.

We'll continue working on improving your experience and we value your feedback!

notes.content:
Welcome back to the club!

Inspiration for relics during development came in all shapes and forms - from extensive research to shower thoughts.

We already have 250 relics, not including cursed versions of some of them. But we could always use more ideas from our community.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/c20f4501263a84c0a867c0070dface5dfd271fb2.gif

So here we’d like to announce a contest for all NecroBouncer players.

Rules are rather simple and straightforward: 

 Play prologue, collect relics and try and come up with an idea for an original relic that should be added to the game.
 Post your suggestion on our Discord Server in the #relic-contest channel.
 One suggestion per player.
 Vote for other players’ suggestions by reacting with a thumbs up. (No voting manipulation)
 Wait till November 11th for the results. They will be posted in the same channel.
 Winner with the most upvotes gets a free key for the NecroBouncer full game. 
 Winner should have his DMs in Discord open. If we don’t get a reply from the winner in 24 hours - we’ll transfer the prize to the suggestion with 2nd best result.


The winner’s relic will be added to the game before the release. 

You can start playing prologue and join us in the club right now:

notes.title: NecroBouncer | Room Types #2
notes.content:
Welcome to the club!

In the previous article, we covered the four available rooms in NecroBouncer. Today we are back with information about the rest of them: Relic Hunt, King of the Hill, Plates & Idols. 

Each of them presents a challenge, especially if you are far into your playthrough.

These rooms will make along with the relics and power-ups you get along the way will make each run of the game unique.

Relic Hunt
This room actually consists of up to four mini-levels. Your goal is to avoid the obstacles and get to the end of each consecutive level. At the end of the said level you will be given two options: either to take the relic and leave the Hunt or delve deeper for a chance to get a better relic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/5d19b4fbf8b08466bfb7449b1d87e638bcbbd6e0.gif

King of the Hill
The premise is very simple - stand on the designated spot till the completion bar is filled. The moment it is filled - all the remaining enemies on screen will be destroyed. You just have to survive long enough.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/3ea15d38f88a317425cf4a9a00b399ec2967b811.gif

Plates
From one to five pressure plates will spawn in the room. When pressed - they spawn enemies (the amount depends on your progress and the difficulty of the room). You can either deal with enemies on plate-by-plate basis or just rush through all of them and deal with a horde of enemies - the choice is up to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/06d1ee76c5cbc66c196f8f8ce83bf76a9b345a7e.gif

Idols
Three plus golden statues will appear. When you break the statue - it will spawn enemies (i.e. golden statue of a blacksmith will spawn a blacksmith). The trick is - with every statue your break - the rest of the grow large, spawning more enemies upon destruction. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/19b56f4cb53f88715e0156dc1ac0af150c2df4cb.gif

You can test your skills in our demo. If you like it - consider adding NecroBouncer to your wishlist. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1786830/NecroBouncer/

As always, we welcome each and every one of our readers to join the club on social media:

 Place for us to share gameplay footage, work-in-progress material and all kinds of sneak peeks - twitter
 A growing library of short clips covering gameplay or just the funny stuff we do - tik-tok
 Lounge to share your thoughts and opinions about the game - discord
 Place to discuss the game, see extra content - reddit

See you in the club!

notes.title: NecroBouncer | Room Types
notes.content:
I welcome you once again to our small corner of the underworld to tell you yet another story.
It won’t cover the topic completely, so you will still have to explore the game for yourself and learn more. Without further ado, may I present the topic of today’s post - the Room types!

Before we continue, I do recommend checking out our socials and learn more about the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1786830/NecroBouncer/

While we do have a plentitude of rooms for visitors to explore, I’ll talk about some of them:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/820a100b7665803cb4e7896aec7424ed6ad4242c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/e083d50d24dc87c9f4bcc3a67f001d07d2542492.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/b89f6bc3a418621f30de241a1fa11964f83b7b9d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/519b7119d553e799522094156260f5a479186eff.png


Let's have a look at which room has to offer:

Seal the portals
Three to six pillars (depending on difficulty) will spawn in this room, and three corresponding portals. You will have to move those pillars by attacking them, into their correct slots. After 15 seconds, all the remaining opened portals will spawn enemies and pillars will lock in place.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/21edd46c2cf327bb34ea817c99f2e76e37dc9515.gif

Charge the pylon
In the middle of this room will be a pylon that is currently turned off. You will have to defeat enemies, which, upon death, will charge the statue a little bit. Enemies will just keep spawning in groups. When the statue is fully charged, it will turn on killing all the remaining enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/3d7533ad8f26931c6b0a22d9d216ccfe4207b9cd.gif

Destroy
In this room, you will have to destroy enemy respawn crystals, which will spawn enemies every 15 seconds. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/37daa25056ba9227b19a5be6e11547cbe94219e2.gif

Bounce
This will be the normal “defeat all enemies” room type. Enemies will spawn in waves. The longer you are in your playthrough - the more enemies you have to beat. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/6ded76c2fe74e37bc94f1eb6b1a40160fbf91d98.gif

As I said before - choice is plentiful and rooms covered here are just a part!

Hope you enjoyed this excourse, we’ll share more content like this later and demo will come out soon, so stay tuned!

Please, consider wishlisting the game and thank you once more for taking your time to join us on the journey of a NecroBouncer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/6daf2f2bd92ffa6ff95c15a8ed228d8759b8fc4d.png

notes.title: Necrobouncer | Outfits
notes.content:
Fellow visitors, welcome!

I welcome you to our small corner of the underworld once more to tell you another story.
Maybe I’d like to do it as big as the previous one. Yet, the topic at hand is not as vast as the history of this place came to be. Without further ado, may I present the topic of today’s post - the Outfits!

Before we continue, I do recommend to check out our socials and learn more about the game! 

While the NecroBouncer started his job at the bar in Devil knows what, we all know - every wardrobe is due an upgrade at some point. Choice is not that big - three outfits in total but we take quality over quantity any day.  They are unlocked by playing the game, yet I suggest we keep exact conditions of unlocking a little secret, just not to spoil too much information in advance.

Let’s see what each outfit is all about.

Base outfit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/da0b3643557af6ee6778e9bc92040a8c55eb1b38.png
Nothing fancy, yet very decent. We had to start with something.

Green skin, purple tie and brown cloak. You will have it until you unlock further  two later down the line.

Gameplay wise:

 Starting HP will be 6
 Starting maximum energy is 20
 Gives you an ability to summon 4 zombies that will attack nearby enemies. 


Caster

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/d18a4121d8575431b1d3c7856bb2a9ca4d7c6c6a.png
This one is a choice for someone with an intention to shock the audience, pun intended.

Gameplay wise:

 Starting HP will be 4
 Starting maximum energy is 30
 Has an ability called Zap which allows you to turn into a ball of lightning and zap in a straight line, damaging enemies that get hit. 


A more skillful bouncer can make use of extra energy.

Corrupted

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/95a043f4384bafd61bf9aa9618e0183155da85a9.png
Would you just look at him, he is pretty much cursed and could give a damn about it.

Outfit for people who go all in or nothing. 

Black & red - color combo that will strike fear into hearts of all unlucky individuals that bothered you during the shift.

Gameplay wise:

 Starting energy is 20
 Starting max HP is 0, but instead he starts with 6 soul HP (temporary hit points, shall we say)
 Abilities cost Soul HP instead of energy to cast
 Whenever you fill full energy capacity -> it will drop back to 0 and give 1 Soul HP instead
 His ability will be “Implode”, which will deal AOE damage around him and fear enemies that get hit, making them run away.


Like I said in the beginning - choice might not be very big, yet every outfit, even the standard one has its own charm so NecroBouncer can choose whichever he sees fit in a particular scenario before shift starts, as long as he unlocked it in one of the previous runs.

Hope you enjoyed excourse into outfits, we’ll share more content like this later, so stay tuned!

Please, consider wishlisting the game and thank you once more for taking your time to join us on the journey of a NecroBouncer!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373929/6daf2f2bd92ffa6ff95c15a8ed228d8759b8fc4d.png
